source.title: Downtown Mobile Alliance Office Market Overview, year end 2024
source.authorization: Manually cited aggregate factual rate from an original publicly released survey; no report prose, listings, addresses, identities or underlying dataset redistributed. No permission claimed to reproduce the report or its survey.
source.method: General-office mixed-service survey anchor; estimated sensitivity of minus/plus 20%. Lease allocations and utilities are original assumptions dated 2026-10-01, not observed quotes.

full_service.basis: Estimate: survey anchor times 0.8 to 1.2; source data 2024-12-31, assumptions 2026-10-01.
Estimate: bundled with base rent in this full-service scenario; verify actual inclusions. Assumption 2026-10-01.
Estimate: original unbundled utilities allowance, not a measured market rate. Assumption 2026-10-01; survey context 2024-12-31.

modified_gross.basis: Estimate: survey sensitivity less an assumed 3/SF expense allocation; source data 2024-12-31, assumptions 2026-10-01.
Estimate: original expense allocation and sensitivity, not a measured market rate. Assumption 2026-10-01; survey context 2024-12-31.
Estimate: original unbundled utilities allowance, not a measured market rate. Assumption 2026-10-01; survey context 2024-12-31.

triple_net.basis: Estimate: survey sensitivity less an assumed 6/SF expense allocation; source data 2024-12-31, assumptions 2026-10-01.
Estimate: original tax, insurance and common-area expense allowance, not a measured market rate. Assumption 2026-10-01; survey context 2024-12-31.
Estimate: original unbundled utilities allowance, not a measured market rate. Assumption 2026-10-01; survey context 2024-12-31.
